events.title: JetBlue Launches Italy Service With Boston-Milan Flights
events.body: JBLU launches nonstop Boston-Milan service, expanding its European reach and targeting premium travelers with Mint cabins and low fares.

events.title: Elizabeth Warren hailed blocking the $3.8B Spirit-JetBlue merger as a 'Biden win for flyers.' Now Spirit is gone
events.body: With Spirit Airlines shuttered after more than three decades in operation, was the decision to block the JetBlue-Spirit merger in 2024 really the right one?
